label: Peplink 8-Port PoE 10G switch (PLS-8-10G-720W)
description: Peplink 8-Port PoE 10G switch - 8x 10GE RJ45 with 802.3bt Type 4 PoE++ (90 W per port, 720 W total budget) and 4x 10GE SFP+ uplinks, 240 Gbps switching capacity, 32,000-entry MAC table, 1U rack-mount with an internal 900 W PSU. Managed through Peplink InControl; a local switch controller is announced but not shipped.
notes: The 720 W is a PoE budget, not a PSU rating: the datasheet lists a 900 W internal supply and 53 W system draw. 802.3bt Type 4 is why every copper port is 90 W - a Type 3 (60 W) reading of the same box would under-power a Wi-Fi 6E access point on a 10G run. Ports are named by what the panel is labelled with rather than by a CLI convention: Peplink publishes no interface naming for this switch, and inventing e.g. `Gi1/0/1` would be a fact the hardware does not state.
